verdict.summary_en: Delivery note DN-260917-127 from Boise Semiconductor Inc. dated 09/17/2026 for PO 4500318717. It covers 10.000 PCS of CMP-GAM-002 (Game Card 64 GB – Grand Heist 5) in 5 packages, gross weight 75 kg, carrier Alpen Air Cargo GmbH. It was stamped RECEIVED 22.09.2026 at DC-HAM and signed 'Schulz P.'. There are no corrections, no remarks and no discrepancy notes.
red_flags: Quantity '10.000' is ambiguous: read as 10,000 pieces (thousands separator) here, because a piece count with decimals makes little sense and 75 kg for 5 packages fits that better. Under an English decimal reading it would be 10. Check against the PO.
Document dates use different formats: delivery note date 09/17/2026 is US format (MM/DD/YYYY), the stamp 22.09.2026 is German format (DD.MM.YYYY).
observations: Handwritten signature 'Schulz P.' under 'Received by', clearly legible.
Blue receiving stamp 'RECEIVED 22.09.2026 / DC-HAM' is clear.
No crossed-out values or handwritten changes visible.
The 'Packages' column header is slightly cut off at the table edge but its content is readable.
Quantity on the note is given without a PO ordered quantity, so no comparison is possible from this document.
